(* --- Sub-Routine 2A: Magnetic Gap Sensor 2oo3 Voter --- *)
rDiffGap_AB := ABS(rGapSensorA_um - rGapSensorB_um);

ELSIF (rDiffGap_AB <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_CA > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_BC > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) THEN

ELSIF (rDiffGap_BC <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_AB > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_CA > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) THEN

    rVotedGap_um := (rGapSensorB_um + rGapSensorC_um) / 2.0;

ELSIF (rDiffGap_CA <= rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_AB > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) AND (rDiffGap_BC > rTMR_GapTolerance_um) THEN

    iEdgeHealthyCount := 2;

    bEdgeSensorAFault := TRUE;
    bEdgeSensorBFault := TRUE;
    bEdgeSensorCFault := TRUE;
    iEdgeHealthyCount := 0;
    rVotedEdge_um := rOpticalWaferEdgeA_um;

wAlarmVectorWord.8  := bEdgeSensorAFault;
wAlarmVectorWord.9  := bEdgeSensorBFault;
wAlarmVectorWord.10 := bEdgeSensorCFault;

(* Degraded Mode Flag Determination *)
bDegradedOperationMode := (iGapHealthyCount = 2) OR (iEdgeHealthyCount = 2);
wAlarmVectorWord.24 := bDegradedOperationMode;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 3: ACTIVE MAGNETIC BEARING LUENBERGER OBSERVER & MPC ESTIMATION
   ==================================================================================================== *)
(* Step 3A: Compute Measurement Innovation: innov = y_meas - C * x_est *)
vecMeasY[1] := rVotedGap_um;
vecMeasY[2] := rVotedGap_um; (* Symmetrical radial gap assumption for spindle *)
vecMeasY[3] := rNominalLevitationGap_um; (* Axial gap reference *)

FOR iRow := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + matC[iRow, iCol] * vecStateX[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecEstY[iRow] := rTempDotProduct;
    vecInnov[iRow] := vecMeasY[iRow] - vecEstY[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* Innovation Divergence Watchdog *)
IF (ABS(vecInnov[1]) > 50.0) OR (ABS(vecInnov[2]) > 50.0) OR (ABS(vecInnov[3]) > 50.0) THEN
    wAlarmVectorWord.23 := TRUE; (* Bit 23: Observer divergence *)
END_IF;

(* Step 3B: State Vector Propagation: x[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k] + L * innov[k] *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    (* State transition contribution *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + matA[iRow, iCol] * vecStateX[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    (* Control input coupling contribution *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + matB[iRow, iCol] * vecCtrlU[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    (* Observer innovation correction contribution *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + matL[iRow, iCol] * vecInnov[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    vecStateX_Next[iRow] := rTempDotProduct;
END_FOR;

(* Update State Estimate for Next Execution Scan *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    vecStateX[iRow] := vecStateX_Next[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* --- Sub-Routine 3C: Model Predictive Control (MPC) Receding Horizon Calculation --- *)
(* Horizon reference initialization (Equilibrium Gap: 1000.0 um) *)
FOR iStep := 1 TO 5 DO
    arrHorizonRef[iStep, 1] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
    arrHorizonRef[iStep, 2] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
    arrHorizonRef[iStep, 3] := rNominalLevitationGap_um;
END_FOR;

(* Evaluate Analytical Cost Gradient over Prediction Horizon *)
vecGradJ[1] := arrMPC_Q_diag[1] * (vecStateX[1] - arrHorizonRef[1, 1]) + arrMPC_R_diag[1] * vecCtrlU[1];
vecGradJ[2] := arrMPC_Q_diag[3] * (vecStateX[3] - arrHorizonRef[1, 2]) + arrMPC_R_diag[2] * vecCtrlU[2];
vecGradJ[3] := arrMPC_Q_diag[5] * (vecStateX[5] - arrHorizonRef[1, 3]) + arrMPC_R_diag[3] * vecCtrlU[3];

(* Execute Constrained Gradient Descent Iterations for Quadratic Programming Step *)
FOR iMPCIter := 1 TO 3 DO
    vecDeltaU[1] := -rMPCAlpha * vecGradJ[1];
    vecDeltaU[2] := -rMPCAlpha * vecGradJ[2];
    vecDeltaU[3] := -rMPCAlpha * vecGradJ[3];
    
    (* Update control vector with saturation ceilings (+/- 12.0 Amperes peak coil current) *)
    vecCtrlU[1] := LIMIT(-12.0, vecCtrlU[1] + vecDeltaU[1], 12.0);
    vecCtrlU[2] := LIMIT(-12.0, vecCtrlU[2] + vecDeltaU[2], 12.0);
    vecCtrlU[3] := LIMIT(-12.0, vecCtrlU[3] + vecDeltaU[3], 12.0);
END_FOR;

(* Compute Scalar Quadratic Cost for Diagnostics *)
rMPCCost := 0.5 * (arrMPC_Q_diag[1] * EXPT(vecStateX[1] - arrHorizonRef[1, 1], 2) +
                   arrMPC_Q_diag[3] * EXPT(vecStateX[3] - arrHorizonRef[1, 2], 2) +
                   arrMPC_Q_diag[5] * EXPT(vecStateX[5] - arrHorizonRef[1, 3], 2) +
                   arrMPC_R_diag[1] * EXPT(vecCtrlU[1], 2) +
                   arrMPC_R_diag[2] * EXPT(vecCtrlU[2], 2) +
                   arrMPC_R_diag[3] * EXPT(vecCtrlU[3], 2));

(* Map AMB Control Currents to Output Terminals *)
rMagLevCurrentX_A := vecCtrlU[1];
rMagLevCurrentY_A := vecCtrlU[2];
rMagLevCurrentZ_A := vecCtrlU[3];

(* Check Gap Error Tolerances *)
IF ABS(vecStateX[1] - rNominalLevitationGap_um) > rMaxGapDeviation_um THEN
    wAlarmVectorWord.6 := TRUE; (* Bit 6: Levitation gap error exceeded *)
ELSE
    wAlarmVectorWord.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 4: 7-SEGMENT JERK-CONSTRAINED S-CURVE TRAJECTORY ENGINE
   Mathematical guarantee: j(t) <= rMaxJerkLimit_mps3, a(t) <= rMaxAccelLimit_mps2.
   ==================================================================================================== *)
IF (iMainState = 60) OR (iMainState = 90) THEN
    (* Advance trajectory clock *)
    rTrajElapsedTime := rTrajElapsedTime + rCycleTime_s;
    
    (* Evaluate Piecewise Analytical Equations for S-Curve Phases *)
    IF rTrajElapsedTime < rTime_Tj1 THEN
        (* Phase 1: Jerk ramp-up to maximum acceleration *)
        iTrajPhase := 1;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 * rTrajElapsedTime;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := 0.5 * rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 * EXPT(rTrajElapsedTime, 2);
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajStartPos_um + (1.0E6 * (1.0 / 6.0) * rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 * EXPT(rTrajElapsedTime, 3));
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta) THEN
        (* Phase 2: Constant peak acceleration plateau *)
        iTrajPhase := 2;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := rMaxAccelLimit_mps2;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := (0.5 * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT(rTime_Tj1, 2)) + (rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 * (rTrajElapsedTime - rTime_Tj1));
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajStartPos_um + 1.0E6 * (
            ( (1.0 / 6.0) * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT(rTime_Tj1, 3) ) +
            ( 0.5 * rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 * EXPT(rTrajElapsedTime - rTime_Tj1, 2) ) +
            ( 0.5 * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT(rTime_Tj1, 2) * (rTrajElapsedTime - rTime_Tj1) )
        );
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta) THEN
        (* Phase 3: Jerk ramp-down to zero acceleration (Peak velocity achieved) *)
        iTrajPhase := 3;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := -rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 - (rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * (rTrajElapsedTime - rTime_Tj1 - rTime_Ta));
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := rMaxVelocityLimit_mps - (0.5 * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT((2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta) - rTrajElapsedTime, 2));
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv) THEN
        (* Phase 4: Constant velocity cruise plateau *)
        iTrajPhase := 4;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := rMaxVelocityLimit_mps;
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajCurrentPos_um + (1.0E6 * rMaxVelocityLimit_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (3.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv) THEN
        (* Phase 5: Deceleration jerk ramp-down to peak deceleration *)
        iTrajPhase := 5;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := -rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := -rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * (rTrajElapsedTime - (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv));
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := rMaxVelocityLimit_mps - (0.5 * rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * EXPT(rTrajElapsedTime - (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv), 2));
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajCurrentPos_um + (1.0E6 * rTrajCurrentVel_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < (3.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv + rTime_Td) THEN
        (* Phase 6: Constant peak deceleration plateau *)
        iTrajPhase := 6;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := -rMaxAccelLimit_mps2;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := rTrajCurrentVel_mps - (rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 * rCycleTime_s);
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajCurrentPos_um + (1.0E6 * rTrajCurrentVel_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        
    ELSIF rTrajElapsedTime < rTime_TotalTraj THEN
        (* Phase 7: Deceleration jerk ramp-up to zero terminal velocity *)
        iTrajPhase := 7;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := -rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 + (rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 * (rTrajElapsedTime - (3.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta + rTime_Tv + rTime_Td)));
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := LIMIT(0.0, rTrajCurrentVel_mps - (ABS(rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2) * rCycleTime_s), rMaxVelocityLimit_mps);
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajCurrentPos_um + (1.0E6 * rTrajCurrentVel_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        
    ELSE
        (* Trajectory Execution Terminal Point *)
        iTrajPhase := 0;
        rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2 := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentVel_mps := 0.0;
        rTrajCurrentPos_um := rTrajTargetDistance_um;
        bTrajComplete := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Trajectory Diagnostic Output Updating *)
    rCurrentTrajectoryJerk_mps3 := rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3;
    rCurrentTrajectoryAccel_mps2 := rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2;
    rCurrentTrajectoryVel_mps := rTrajCurrentVel_mps;
    
    (* Enforce Jerk and Slip Acceleration Safety Alarms *)
    IF ABS(rTrajCurrentJerk_mps3) > (rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 + 0.05) THEN
        wAlarmVectorWord.13 := TRUE; (* Bit 13: Jerk ceiling breach *)
    END_IF;
    IF ABS(rTrajCurrentAccel_mps2) > (rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 + 0.05) THEN
        wAlarmVectorWord.14 := TRUE; (* Bit 14: Wafer slip acceleration exceeded *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCurrentTrajectoryJerk_mps3 := 0.0;
    rCurrentTrajectoryAccel_mps2 := 0.0;
    rCurrentTrajectoryVel_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 5: INVERSE KINEMATICS & MOTOR TORQUE FEEDFORWARD
   SCARA 2-link analytic geometry resolution:
     Reach R = sqrt(X^2 + Y^2)
     cos(theta2) = (R^2 - L1^2 - L2^2) / (2 * L1 * L2)
     sin(theta2) = sqrt(1 - cos^2(theta2))
     theta1 = atan2(Y, X) - atan2(L2 * sin(theta2), L1 + L2 * cos(theta2))
   ==================================================================================================== *)
rPlanarX_um := rTargetRadius_um * COS(rTargetTheta_deg * (rPI / 180.0));
rPlanarY_um := rTargetRadius_um * SIN(rTargetTheta_deg * (rPI / 180.0));
rRadialReachSquare := EXPT(rPlanarX_um, 2) + EXPT(rPlanarY_um, 2);

(* Inverse Kinematic Workspace Singularity Surveillance *)
IF (rRadialReachSquare > EXPT(rArmLength1_um + rArmLength2_um - 1000.0, 2)) OR
   (rRadialReachSquare < EXPT(rArmLength1_um - rArmLength2_um + 1000.0, 2)) THEN
    wAlarmVectorWord.18 := TRUE; (* Bit 18: Kinematic singularity boundary exceeded *)
ELSE
    wAlarmVectorWord.18 := FALSE;
    
    (* Law of Cosines for Elbow Joint Angle Theta2 *)
    rCosJ2 := (rRadialReachSquare - EXPT(rArmLength1_um, 2) - EXPT(rArmLength2_um, 2)) / (2.0 * rArmLength1_um * rArmLength2_um);
    rCosJ2 := LIMIT(-1.0, rCosJ2, 1.0);
    rSinJ2 := SQRT(1.0 - EXPT(rCosJ2, 2));
    rTargetAngleJ2_rad := ATAN2(rSinJ2, rCosJ2);
    
    (* Shoulder Joint Angle Theta1 *)
    rTargetAngleJ1_rad := ATAN2(rPlanarY_um, rPlanarX_um) - ATAN2(rArmLength2_um * rSinJ2, rArmLength1_um + (rArmLength2_um * rCosJ2));
    
    (* Dynamic Torque Feedforward: Tau = M(theta)*ddTheta + V(theta, dTheta) + F_friction *)
    rJointTorqueFF_J1_Nm := (rLinkMass1_kg + rLinkMass2_kg + rWaferPayloadMass_kg) * 0.45 * (rCurrentTrajectoryAccel_mps2 * 0.45);
    rJointTorqueFF_J2_Nm := (rLinkMass2_kg + rWaferPayloadMass_kg) * 0.25 * (rCurrentTrajectoryAccel_mps2 * 0.25);
    
    rCommandedMotorTorqueJ1_Nm := rJointTorqueFF_J1_Nm + (rJointFriction_Nm * (rCurrentTrajectoryVel_mps / (rMaxVelocityLimit_mps + 0.001)));
    rCommandedMotorTorqueJ2_Nm := rJointTorqueFF_J2_Nm + (rJointFriction_Nm * (rCurrentTrajectoryVel_mps / (rMaxVelocityLimit_mps + 0.001)));
    rCommandedMotorTorqueZ_Nm := (rWaferPayloadMass_kg + 3.5) * 9.80665 * 0.005 / (2.0 * rPI); (* Ball screw gravity lead compensation *)
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   STAGE 6: MULTI-STAGE CASE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)

   ==================================================================================================== *)

        tMagLevSettleTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#800MS);
        IF tMagLevSettleTimer.Q THEN
            tMagLevSettleTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify 2oo3 gap consensus within +/- 5 um of nominal *)
            IF ABS(rVotedGap_um - rNominalLevitationGap_um) <= 5.0 THEN
                bRobotActive := TRUE;
                iMainState := 30;
            ELSE
                wAlarmVectorWord.6 := TRUE;
                iMainState := 999; (* Failed to establish levitation equilibrium *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 30: ACTIVE MAGNETIC BEARING CLOSED-LOOP SUSPENSION
          High-bandwidth active vibration isolation locked. Verify seismic disturbances are damped.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#3100; (* SEMI E10 LEVITATION LOCKED *)
        
        IF (ABS(vecStateX[2]) < 0.5) AND (ABS(vecStateX[4]) < 0.5) THEN
            (* Velocity jitter sufficiently damped: proceed to calibration *)
            IF bCalibrateZeroReference THEN
                iMainState := 40;
            ELSE
                iMainState := 50; (* Ready for transfer dispatch *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 40: KINEMATIC HOMING & OPTICAL RETICLE ZERO CALIBRATION
          Sub-micron zero-positioning against calibrated vacuum optical reticle.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#3200; (* SEMI E10 CALIBRATING *)
        
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Calibration sequence completed *)
            iMainState := 50;
        END_IF;

    50: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 50: CLUSTER TRANSFER DISPATCH READY (STANDBY IDLE)
          Waiting for upper-level MES / SECS-GEM wafer transfer dispatch trigger.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#4000; (* SEMI E10 IDLE / READY FOR DISPATCH *)
        bWaferCentered := FALSE;
        
        IF bEnable AND (rTargetRadius_um > 250000.0) AND bChamberGateValveOpen THEN
            (* Valid move dispatch command received: Configure S-curve trajectory parameters *)
            rTrajStartPos_um := 0.0;
            rTrajTargetDistance_um := rTargetRadius_um;
            rTrajElapsedTime := 0.0;
            bTrajComplete := FALSE;
            
            (* Compute 7-Segment Kinematic Durations *)
            rTime_Tj1 := rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 / rMaxJerkLimit_mps3;
            rTime_Ta := (rMaxVelocityLimit_mps / rMaxAccelLimit_mps2) - rTime_Tj1;
            IF rTime_Ta < 0.0 THEN
                (* Triangular velocity profile (acceleration limit not fully reached) *)
                rTime_Ta := 0.0;
                rTime_Tj1 := SQRT(rMaxVelocityLimit_mps / rMaxJerkLimit_mps3);
            END_IF;
            rTime_Tj2 := rTime_Tj1;
            rTime_Td := rTime_Ta;
            
            (* Calculate cruise plateau duration *)
            rTime_Tv := (rTrajTargetDistance_um * 1.0E-6 / rMaxVelocityLimit_mps) - (2.0 * rTime_Tj1 + rTime_Ta);
            IF rTime_Tv < 0.0 THEN
                rTime_Tv := 0.0; (* Short stroke: no cruise plateau *)
            END_IF;
            
            rTime_TotalTraj := (4.0 * rTime_Tj1) + (2.0 * rTime_Ta) + rTime_Tv;
            iMainState := 60; (* Enter trajectory execution *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 60: TRAJECTORY GENERATION - S-CURVE JERK SUPPRESSION APPROACH
          Moving SCARA end-effector toward target wafer cassette / chamber station under jerk limit.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#5000; (* SEMI E10 EXECUTING / MOTION ACTIVE *)
        
        IF bTrajComplete THEN
            (* S-curve motion profile completed: transition to optical edge alignment scan *)
            iMainState := 70;
            iSubState := 0;
            bNotchDetected := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    70: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 70: HIGH-PRECISION WAFER EDGE OPTICAL SCAN & CIRCLE FIT
          Rotational scanning using through-beam laser PSD sensors to reconstruct wafer perimeter.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#5100; (* SEMI E10 ALIGNING / OPTICAL SCANNING *)
        
        CASE iSubState OF
            0: (* Capture Point 1: 0 degrees azimuth *)
                rScanPoint1_X := rVotedEdge_um * COS(0.0);
                rScanPoint1_Y := rVotedEdge_um * SIN(0.0);
                iSubState := 1;
                
            1: (* Capture Point 2: 120 degrees azimuth *)
                rScanPoint2_X := rVotedEdge_um * COS(120.0 * (rPI / 180.0));
                rScanPoint2_Y := rVotedEdge_um * SIN(120.0 * (rPI / 180.0));
                iSubState := 2;
                
            2: (* Capture Point 3: 240 degrees azimuth *)
                rScanPoint3_X := rVotedEdge_um * COS(240.0 * (rPI / 180.0));
                rScanPoint3_Y := rVotedEdge_um * SIN(240.0 * (rPI / 180.0));
                iSubState := 3;
                
            3: (* Solve Determinant & Circle Geometry *)
                (* Calculate determinant: D = 2 * (x1*(y2-y3) - y1*(x2-x3) + x2*y3 - x3*y2) *)
                rCircFitDetD := 2.0 * (
                    rScanPoint1_X * (rScanPoint2_Y - rScanPoint3_Y) -
                    rScanPoint1_Y * (rScanPoint2_X - rScanPoint3_X) +
                    (rScanPoint2_X * rScanPoint3_Y) -
                    (rScanPoint3_X * rScanPoint2_Y)
                );
                
                IF ABS(rCircFitDetD) > 1.0E-6 THEN
                    rCircFitTerm1 := EXPT(rScanPoint1_X, 2) + EXPT(rScanPoint1_Y, 2);
                    rCircFitTerm2 := EXPT(rScanPoint2_X, 2) + EXPT(rScanPoint2_Y, 2);
                    rCircFitTerm3 := EXPT(rScanPoint3_X, 2) + EXPT(rScanPoint3_Y, 2);
                    
                    (* Reconstruct Center Offset (Xc, Yc) *)
                    rWaferCenterX_um := (
                        rCircFitTerm1 * (rScanPoint2_Y - rScanPoint3_Y) +
                        rCircFitTerm2 * (rScanPoint3_Y - rScanPoint1_Y) +
                        rCircFitTerm3 * (rScanPoint1_Y - rScanPoint2_Y)
                    ) / rCircFitDetD;
                    
                    rWaferCenterY_um := (
                        rCircFitTerm1 * (rScanPoint3_X - rScanPoint2_X) +
                        rCircFitTerm2 * (rScanPoint1_X - rScanPoint3_X) +
                        rCircFitTerm3 * (rScanPoint2_X - rScanPoint1_X)
                    ) / rCircFitDetD;
                    
                    (* Reconstruct Radius R *)
                    rEstimatedWaferRadius_um := SQRT(EXPT(rScanPoint1_X - rWaferCenterX_um, 2) + EXPT(rScanPoint1_Y - rWaferCenterY_um, 2));
                    
                    (* Thermal Expansion CTE Compensation: R_comp = R_nom * (1 + alpha * (T - T_ref)) *)
                    rWaferCompensatedRadius_um := (rWaferDiameterNominal_um / 2.0) * (1.0 + (rSiliconCTE_ppm * (rWaferTemp_degC - rReferenceTemp_degC)));
                    
                    (* Radius Integrity Verification *)
                    IF ABS(rEstimatedWaferRadius_um - rWaferCompensatedRadius_um) > 350.0 THEN
                        wAlarmVectorWord.11 := TRUE; (* Bit 11: Wafer radius out of spec *)
                        iMainState := 999;
                    ELSE
                        wAlarmVectorWord.11 := FALSE;
                        rCalculatedWaferEccentricity_um := SQRT(EXPT(rWaferCenterX_um, 2) + EXPT(rWaferCenterY_um, 2));
                        iSubState := 4;
                    END_IF;
                ELSE
                    wAlarmVectorWord.27 := TRUE; (* Collinear edge points fit failure *)
                    iMainState := 999;
                END_IF;
                
            4: (* Notch Identification Scan via Second Difference Filter *)
                rEdgeDeriv1 := rVotedEdge_um - rPrevEdgeVal;
                rEdgeDeriv2 := rVotedEdge_um - (2.0 * rPrevEdgeVal) + rPrevPrevEdgeVal;
                rPrevPrevEdgeVal := rPrevEdgeVal;
                rPrevEdgeVal := rVotedEdge_um;
                
                (* SEMI standard wafer notch exhibits characteristic 1.0 mm trough spike *)
                IF rEdgeDeriv2 > 150.0 THEN
                    bNotchDetected := TRUE;
                    rCalculatedWaferNotchAngle_deg := rTargetTheta_deg;
                    iMainState := 80; (* Transition to eccentricity correction *)
                END_IF;
                
                tNotchSearchTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);
                IF tNotchSearchTimer.Q THEN
                    tNotchSearchTimer(IN := FALSE);
                    wAlarmVectorWord.12 := TRUE; (* Bit 12: Notch search timeout *)
                    iMainState := 80; (* Proceed with degraded notch angle *)
                END_IF;
        END_CASE;

    80: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 80: END-EFFECTOR ECCENTRICITY VECTOR CORRECTION
          Fine-pitch micro-stepping of SCARA shoulder and elbow to nullify eccentricity vector.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#5200; (* SEMI E10 CORRECTING ECCENTRICITY *)
        
        IF rCalculatedWaferEccentricity_um <= 1.50 THEN
            (* Sub-micron centering verified within cleanroom specification (+/- 1.50 um) *)
            bWaferCentered := TRUE;
            
            (* Engage vacuum / electrostatic chuck *)
            IF bEngageWaferVacuumChuck THEN
                iMainState := 90;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* Closed-loop nudge correction: apply micro-step offset to target coordinates *)
            rPlanarX_um := rPlanarX_um - (0.5 * rWaferCenterX_um);
            rPlanarY_um := rPlanarY_um - (0.5 * rWaferCenterY_um);
            rCalculatedWaferEccentricity_um := rCalculatedWaferEccentricity_um * 0.45; (* Damped reduction *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 90: CONTROLLED RETRACT & INTER-CHAMBER SLIT PASSAGE
          Withdrawing wafer through slit valve opening into transfer chamber core.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#5300; (* SEMI E10 TRANSITING SLIT VALVE *)
        
        tChamberTransferWatchdog(IN := TRUE, PT := T#6S);
        IF bTrajComplete THEN
            tChamberTransferWatchdog(IN := FALSE);
            iMainState := 100;
        END_IF;
        
        IF tChamberTransferWatchdog.Q THEN
            tChamberTransferWatchdog(IN := FALSE);
            wAlarmVectorWord.25 := TRUE; (* Bit 25: Slit transit cycle time watchdog expired *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 100: TARGET STATION DEPOSIT & SETTLING VERIFICATION
          Wafer delivered to process station lift pins; verifying settling vibration decay.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#6000; (* SEMI E10 TRANSFER COMPLETE / SETTLING *)
        
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#400MS);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF NOT bEngageWaferVacuumChuck THEN
                (* Substrate released cleanly onto lift pins *)
                iMainState := 50; (* Return to ready idle state *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    900: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 900: DEGRADED OPERATION MODE (1oo2 SENSOR REDUNDANCY RECOVERY)
          Operating under single sensor channel failure with throttled acceleration limits.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#7000; (* SEMI E10 DEGRADED PRODUCTIVE MODE *)
        bDegradedOperationMode := TRUE;
        
        (* Graceful degradation: Reduce motion ceilings by 50% to minimize bearing disturbance *)
        rMaxVelocityLimit_mps := 0.20;
        rMaxAccelLimit_mps2 := 0.30;
        rMaxJerkLimit_mps3 := 0.60;
        
        (* If all sensors restored, return to normal operation *)
        IF (iGapHealthyCount = 3) AND (iEdgeHealthyCount = 3) THEN
            bDegradedOperationMode := FALSE;
            iMainState := 50;
        END_IF;

    999: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 999: EMERGENCY SAFE LANDING & CONTROLLED ARREST
          Controlled eddy-current soft landing onto ceramic backup touchdown bearings.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wClusterToolStatusWord := 16#F001; (* SEMI E10 EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN / TOUCHDOWN *)
        bRobotActive := FALSE;
        bWaferCentered := FALSE;
        bSafeTransferInterlockOk := FALSE;
        
        (* Controlled magnetic flux decay to prevent high-velocity mechanical impact *)
        rMagLevCurrentX_A := rMagLevCurrentX_A * 0.92;
        rMagLevCurrentY_A := rMagLevCurrentY_A * 0.92;
        rMagLevCurrentZ_A := rMagLevCurrentZ_A * 0.92;
        
        rCommandedMotorTorqueJ1_Nm := 0.0;
        rCommandedMotorTorqueJ2_Nm := 0.0;
        rCommandedMotorTorqueZ_Nm := 0.0;
        
        (* Remain locked in landing state until explicit master reset *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEmergencyStop AND (wAlarmVectorWord = 0) THEN
            iMainState := 0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* UNHANDLED STATE EXCEPTION TRAP *)
        wAlarmVectorWord.30 := TRUE; (* Bit 30: Unhandled sequencer state trap *)
        iMainState := 999;
END_CASE;

(* Update History State Pointer *)
iPrevState := iMainState;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
